paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.14% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+1.02%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.38%). Brent crude changed +2.69% to 109.52. Gold changed -0.77% to 4,158.3999. Bitcoin changed +0.45% to 81,931.1562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.146%, a relative move of -1.79%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (-8.70%) and Bank of America (-7.52%) moved the most.
